description.value: You have spent a lot of time using weapons underwater, and you know how to modify them to function as well as they would on land. By spending 10 minutes with a weapon, you alter it to function better underwater for the next 24 hours. If it is a bludgeoning or slashing weapon, the wielder no longer takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls with it. If it is a ranged weapon, its range increment is no longer halved.
